about_the_game:
For the first time in Virtual Reality, SETVR XL-Unleashed lets players experience real, physical combat—not through buttons or animations, but through natural movement and real-life actions. Built specifically for VR, the game puts your body at the center of every fight. Face off against intelligent AI opponents or challenge real players from around the world in live, real-time battles that test your skill, reflexes, and endurance.

Designed and optimized for Meta Quest, SETVR XL-Unleashed introduces a breakthrough feature: true bare-hand combat with no controllers required. Punch, block, and spar using only your hands, just as you would in real life. Prefer weapons? Seamlessly switch to controller-based combat for a different style of intensity. Sparring with someone across the world has never felt this natural—or this real.

Whether you enjoy focused solo training or competitive multiplayer, this experience keeps you fully engaged. Every fight feels physical, every movement matters, and no two sessions play the same. The game is optimized for room-scale play, allowing you to move freely and fight without artificial limits.

For players drawn to combative self-defense, martial arts, or fitness-driven gameplay, SETVR XL-Unleashed delivers meaningful challenges that help improve technique, stamina, and overall physical conditioning. Competitive fighting fans can push their limits, climb scores, and master new combat styles—while enjoying a full-body workout that feels like play, not exercise.

More Ways to Play and Progress

  • Bow and arrow challenges that reward precision and control

  • Guns, knives, and shuriken shooting galleries for fast-paced skill mastery

  • Combat training modes designed to sharpen reflexes and technique

Need a break? Step into the Meditation and Yoga areas to recover, refocus, and return stronger for your next fight.

SETVR XL-Unleashed also offers a unique educational experience set in a beautifully crafted Japanese Village, where historical generals and environments deepen your understanding and appreciation of martial arts culture and tradition.

Prepare yourself for a VR experience that blends combat, fitness, competition, and exploration into one immersive world.

Get ready to move.
Get ready to fight.
Get ready for SETVR XL-Unleashed.

Note : To enjoy the hand tracking feature you must set your Meta Quest Link App as Open XR Runtime from Settings > General > Set Meta Quest Link As OpenXR Runtime.  

Hand tracking works with Meta devices, including ( Meta Quest 2, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 3, and Meta Quest 3S ) with Meta Quest Link ( Air Link or cable) & Meta Quest Link is set to - Active Open XR runtime.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3S, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 2
  • Additional Notes: Requires Oculus Link (USB-C) or Air Link
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (6 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Meta Quest 3S, Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, Meta Quest 2
  • Additional Notes: Requires Oculus Link (USB-C) or Air Link

short_description: SETVR XL-Unleashed delivers true, full-body VR combat using real movement not buttons. Fight AI opponents or real players worldwide in real time using bare-hand tracking with no controllers, or switch to weapon combat for added intensity. Train, compete, and explore immersive combat experiences.
